about: How many option periods a contract's own award document allows, read by hand for renewals.html. DC's site does not publish this, and it never lists an option period before it is exercised. Each entry was read from the award PDF on DC's site on the date in 'checked'. 'period' and 'end_date' are the current period on DC's site at that check; renewals.html applies an entry only while DC's site still shows that same period, so an entry goes quiet instead of going stale. A blank status on the page means nobody has read the paperwork, not that options remain or run out.
